title: Steam locomotive
prompt: a red steam locomotive on a length of track: shovel coal into the firebox, build steam pressure, open the regulator and pull the whistle as puffs rise and the driving wheels turn; see-through shows the firebox, boiler tubes, steam dome, cylinders, pistons and connecting rods
blurb: A red tank engine on its track: stoke the fire, raise steam, open the regulator and watch the pistons, rods and driving wheels push it along.
